body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on yourself until the start of your next turn, even on a miss.

surges.html: An adjacent willing ally may receive the suppression instead.
On a hit, reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Finisher
rider.html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to preserve the numerical suppression through the end of your next turn. No Wound is removed or downgraded.
